fields.value: Supplier may terminate on 3 months’ written notice; Distributor may terminate on 6 months’ written notice.

quotes.text:
The Supplier may terminate this Agreement by giving three (3) months’ written notice. The
Distributor may terminate this Agreement by giving six (6) months’ written notice.

fields.value: Either party may terminate by written notice for material breach not remedied within 14 days after written request.

quotes.text:
Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice if the other party is in material breach
of it and has not put the breach right within fourteen (14) days of being asked in writing to do so.

fields.value: Neither party’s total liability under the Agreement shall exceed S$250,000 in aggregate.

quotes.text:
Except for liability which cannot lawfully be excluded, neither party’s total liability under this
Agreement shall exceed S$250,000 in aggregate.

fields.value: Sole distributorship: Kestrel Instruments Limited appoints Lionbridge Distribution Pte Ltd as sole distributor of the Products in Singapore; the Supplier will not appoint others but may sell directly to end customers.

quotes.text:
The Supplier appoints the Distributor as its sole distributor of the Products in the Territory.
The Supplier will not appoint any other distributor, reseller or agent for the Products in the
Territory during the Term. The Supplier reserves the right to continue to supply the Products
directly to end customers in the Territory, and any such direct sales shall not be a breach of this
clause.

“Products” means the Supplier’s benchtop analytical instruments and dedicated consumables
within Product Category X, as listed in the Schedule.
“Territory” means Singapore.

payments.description: Annual trade mark licence fee payable by the Distributor.

quotes.text:
The Distributor shall pay an annual licence fee of S$10,000 on 1 January in each year of the
Term, in consideration of the trade mark licence granted under clause 6.1.

This Agreement starts on 8 May 2026 and runs for twenty-four (24) months, ending on 8 May
2028 unless it is terminated earlier under clause 11.

ambiguities: Clause 6.2 Annual licence fee says the fee is payable on 1 January in each year of the Term, but clause 2.1 Term says the Term starts on 8 May 2026; it does not state whether or when a 2026 fee is payable.

payments.description: Minimum annual purchase commitment for the Products.
